# Checkpoint

Implemented `ansible-galaxy collection install -U/--upgrade` and passed it through `install_collections`, `_resolve_depenency_map`, and the dependency provider. Root cause: `install_collections` returned early for an installed direct requirement, and the provider always prioritized installed candidates. Upgrade mode now resolves direct requests against available versions, retains installed dependencies when compatible, replaces them when their constraints require it, and skips reinstalling an already selected version. Added unit tests and `test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml`.

Verification: `PYTHONPATH=lib pytest -q --reruns 0 test/units/galaxy/test_collection_install.py test/units/galaxy/test_collection.py test/units/cli/galaxy` passed (104 tests). YAML parsing of the new upgrade task and main task passed. `git diff --check` passed. The service-backed integration target was not executed locally; its Galaxy/Pulp services were not started for this check, so end-to-end integration behavior remains to be confirmed by CI. `rg` was unavailable; `grep` was used for repository search.

+---
+- name: install an older collection for upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:1.0.0 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+
+- name: write upgrade requirements
+  copy:
+    dest: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml'
+    content: |
+      collections:
+        - name: namespace1.name1
+          version: '<1.1.0'
+        - name: namespace2.name
+
+- name: upgrade collections from requirements
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U -r '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+  register: upgrade_result
+
+- name: inspect upgraded collection
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: upgraded_manifest
+
+- name: verify constrained upgrade
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - "(upgraded_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.0.9'"
+      - "'namespace1.name1:1.0.9' in upgrade_result.stdout"
+
+- name: repeat upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade -r '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+  register: repeated_upgrade
+
+- name: verify upgrade is idempotent
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - "'Installing' not in repeated_upgrade.stdout"
+
+- name: upgrade with pre-release versions enabled
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U --pre namespace1.name1 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade'
+
+- name: inspect pre-release upgrade
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: pre_upgrade_manifest
+
+- name: verify pre-release upgrade
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - "(pre_upgrade_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.1.0-beta.1'"

+def test_upgrade_resolves_latest_requested_and_required_dependency(monkeypatch, tmp_path_factory, galaxy_server):
+    test_dir = to_bytes(tmp_path_factory.mktemp('upgrade collections'))
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(test_dir, validate_certs=False)
+    versions = {'parent.collection': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'], 'child.collection': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0']}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions',
+                        lambda namespace, name: versions['%s.%s' % (namespace, name)])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_version_metadata',
+                        lambda namespace, name, version: api.CollectionVersionMetadata(
+                            namespace, name, version, None, None,
+                            {'child.collection': '>=2.0.0'} if namespace == 'parent' and version == '2.0.0' else {}))
+    installed = {Candidate('parent.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir'),
+                 Candidate('child.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')}
+    requirements = [Requirement('parent.collection', '*', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    result = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [galaxy_server], manager, installed, False, False,
+                                                 upgrade=True)
+
+    assert result['parent.collection'].ver == '2.0.0'
+    assert result['child.collection'].ver == '2.0.0'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('constraint,pre,expected', [
+    ('<2.0.0', False, '1.5.0'),
+    ('*', False, '2.0.0'),
+    ('*', True, '3.0.0-beta.1'),
+])
+def test_upgrade_respects_constraints_and_prereleases(monkeypatch, tmp_path_factory, galaxy_server,
+                                                       constraint, pre, expected):
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(
+        to_bytes(tmp_path_factory.mktemp('upgrade versions')), validate_certs=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions',
+                        lambda namespace, name: ['1.0.0', '1.5.0', '2.0.0', '3.0.0-beta.1'])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_version_metadata',
+                        lambda namespace, name, version: api.CollectionVersionMetadata(
+                            namespace, name, version, None, None, {}))
+    requirements = [Requirement('namespace.collection', constraint, None, 'galaxy')]
+    installed = {Candidate('namespace.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')}
+
+    result = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [galaxy_server], manager, installed, False, pre,
+                                                 upgrade=True)
+
+    assert result['namespace.collection'].ver == expected
+
+
+def test_upgrade_no_deps_leaves_dependency_unchanged(monkeypatch, tmp_path_factory, galaxy_server):
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(
+        to_bytes(tmp_path_factory.mktemp('upgrade no deps')), validate_certs=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions', lambda namespace, name: ['2.0.0'])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_version_metadata',
+                        lambda namespace, name, version: api.CollectionVersionMetadata(
+                            namespace, name, version, None, None, {'child.collection': '>=2.0.0'}))
+    requirements = [Requirement('parent.collection', '*', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    result = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [galaxy_server], manager, None, True, False,
+                                                 upgrade=True)
+
+    assert set(result) == {'parent.collection'}
+
+
+def test_upgrade_requirements_file_passes_upgrade_to_installer(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    requirements_file = tmp_path / 'requirements.yml'
+    requirements_file.write_text('collections:\n  - name: namespace.collection\n    version: "<2.0.0"\n')
+    install_mock = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.cli.galaxy.install_collections', install_mock)
+
+    call_galaxy_cli(['install', '-U', '-r', to_text(requirements_file), '-p', to_text(tmp_path)])
+
+    assert install_mock.call_count == 1
+    assert install_mock.call_args[1]['upgrade'] is True
+    assert install_mock.call_args[0][0][0].ver == '<2.0.0'
+
+
+def test_upgrade_installs_only_when_newer_version_exists(monkeypatch, tmp_path, galaxy_server):
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(to_bytes(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    installed = [Candidate('namespace.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'find_existing_collections', lambda path, art_mgr: installed)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions', lambda namespace, name: ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_version_metadata',
+                        lambda namespace, name, version: api.CollectionVersionMetadata(

+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'install', install_mock)

+
+    collection.install_collections(requirements, to_text(tmp_path), [galaxy_server], False, False,
+                                   False, False, False, manager, upgrade=True)
+    assert install_mock.call_count == 1
+    assert install_mock.call_args[0][0].ver == '2.0.0'
+
+    installed[:] = [Candidate('namespace.collection', '2.0.0', None, 'dir')]
+    collection.install_collections(requirements, to_text(tmp_path), [galaxy_server], False, False,
+                                   False, False, False, manager, upgrade=True)
+    assert install_mock.call_count == 1
+
+
+def test_upgrade_reports_unsatisfied_constraint(monkeypatch, tmp_path, galaxy_server):
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(to_bytes(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions', lambda namespace, name: ['1.0.0'])
+    requirements = [Requirement('namespace.collection', '>=2.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]

+def test_upgrade_resolves_latest_requested_and_required_dependency(monkeypatch, tmp_path_factory, galaxy_server):
+    test_dir = to_bytes(tmp_path_factory.mktemp('upgrade collections'))
+    manager = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(test_dir, validate_certs=False)
+    versions = {'parent.collection': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'], 'child.collection': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0']}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions',
+                        lambda namespace, name: versions['%s.%s' % (namespace, name)])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_version_metadata',
+                        lambda namespace, name, version: api.CollectionVersionMetadata(
+                            namespace, name, version, None, None,
+                            {'child.collection': '>=2.0.0'} if namespace == 'parent' and version == '2.0.0' else {}))
+    installed = {Candidate('parent.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir'),
+                 Candidate('child.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')}
+    requirements = [Requirement('parent.collection', '*', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    result = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [galaxy_server], manager, installed, False, False,
+                                                 upgrade=True)
+
+    assert result['parent.collection'].ver == '2.0.0'
+    assert result['child.collection'].ver == '2.0.0'
+

+                        lambda namespace, name, version: api.CollectionVersionMetadata(

+    installed = {Candidate('namespace.collection', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')}
+
+    result = collection._resolve_depenency_map(requirements, [galaxy_server], manager, installed, False, pre,
